notes: Built from ep008.ts lines: only tags and CAPITALS added; words identical to say.
persona: You are an energetic, charismatic YouTuber narrating a vertical short video, talking straight to one friend who is in serious trouble. Conversational, expressive, urgent and a little mischievous, with natural breaths. Change your speed, pitch, emphasis and rhythm with what is happening: an urgent hook, tension that climbs line by line (a little faster and tighter each time), a punchy drop at the blackout, relief when the survival news comes, thrilled storytelling for the true story, and a warm, friendly call to action. Words in CAPITALS get extra emphasis. Each line starts with a direction in parentheses: follow it, but never read the directions or the bracketed tags aloud. Keep a brisk, punchy pace throughout, about 175 words per minute: no long pauses inside a line.

lines.style: urgent and quick, right in your ear, hit the number hard
lines.tagged: You just stepped into space with NO suit. You have about FIFTEEN seconds.
The air in your lungs rushes STRAIGHT out.

lines.style: quick and fascinated, three short punches
lines.tagged: Your spit starts to BOIL. Not from heat. From NO pressure.

lines.style: amazed, a little gleeful at how strange it is
lines.tagged: And that boiling chills your mouth to nearly FREEZING.
But your blood WON'T boil, and you WON'T explode.

lines.style: playful and a bit grossed out, brisk
lines.tagged: You just SWELL, up to TWICE your normal volume.

lines.style: suddenly tense and lower, slowing slightly
lines.tagged: Then your blood runs out of OXYGEN.

lines.style: quiet and final, a dramatic drop in the voice
bright surprise and relief, picking the pace back up
lines.tagged: But you're ALIVE. Get pressure back within about NINETY seconds, and you could WAKE up.

lines.style: leaning in, thrilled, clear on the year
lines.tagged: This REALLY happened. Nineteen sixty six, inside a NASA vacuum chamber.

lines.style: storytelling, building, say the name very clearly: Jim Le Blonk
lines.tagged: Jim LeBlanc was testing a space suit when its air hose came OFF.
His LAST memory? Spit BOILING on his tongue.

lines.style: triumphant and warm, clear on the number
lines.tagged: The chamber refilled in eighty seven seconds. He WOKE up, no lasting harm.
What should you survive next? The BEST comment becomes the next video.
